designer.what: Render the Site stats item into the page (fix 4: footer counts and the head story count stop downloading /stories and /sitemap.xml).
steps: On each page, as a page-level element directly before the TLL Site Footer instance (a sibling, NOT inside the footer or nav component): add a Div Block with the custom attribute hidden = hidden.
Inside it add a Collection List bound to Site stats (collection 6ae602821fa37291336b5680), limit 1 item. Leave the Empty State inside the hidden div.
Inside the Collection Item add an Embed with exactly: where each capital word is replaced with the Embed's Add Field for the Number field of the same name (stories, travelers, pets, countries).
Read back in the published HTML: one span[data-tll-site-stats] per page with four whole numbers equal to the item (57, 6, 1, 54 on 13 Nov).
designer.why_not_the_footer: The footer component is on every page and would be the natural place, but the footer component is out of bounds for this work. Pages without D1 keep today's behavior (one /stories and two sitemap requests per new visitor).

designer.what: Render Magnus's country list into the pages that show his number (fix 4: home, /the-paw-passport, /about stop downloading his pet page). The /the-paw-passport count stays bound to the Pets item.
steps: In the same hidden Div Block as D1 on these pages, add a Collection List bound to Pets (collection 6a0be8194ccc05a63fbdcfa3), limit 20, no filter.

Inside the Collection Item add an Embed with exactly: with Add Field for Slug and for the plain text field Countries list (countries-list), which is the field the pet page prints as window.TLL_PET.countries.
Read back: span[data-tll-pet="magnus-waffles"] carries the same text as TLL_PET.countries on /pets/magnus-waffles.
designer.caveat: A double quote typed into Countries list would end the attribute early. The pet page has the same limit today (it prints the field inside a JS string).

owner_ok_required.block: INSIDE THE FOOTER COMPONENT "TLL Site Footer" (710ff458-c06e-d602-a663-e5e88ca1456b): the HtmlEmbed holding <style id=tll-foot-v1> and the footer scripts (repo src/components/footer/tll-foot-v1.html), commissioned label script, function home()
owner_ok_required.why: This block is inside the footer component (TLL Site Footer). Hard rule: no footer component edits without the owner's explicit word. Effect: home makes one /stories request instead of two (77.5 KB less per home first view). Without it everything else still works.

not_changed_and_why: tll-live-counts-v3.3 (footer component embed): unchanged. It already reads sessionStorage tllCounts5 first; the core seeds that key from D1 before its DOMContentLoaded run, so it never fetches where D1 is.
tll-live-stories-v1 (site head code): unchanged, same reason (tllStoryN).

Home library rail (h3-shelf-js): still reads /stories once per home view to add stories newer than the ten cards typed in its embed (E5 only shares the request). Removing that request needs the rail to be built from a Stories collection list, a larger Designer change; not done here so the rail stays exactly as it is.
tll_home_story_counter and tllacctpetsv1 (registered scripts): no request on these pages (their elements are absent or the account page only).
